**Subject:** Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. It has a customer service chatbot deployed on its support portal, an AI visual inspection pilot on the German production line and AI sales forecasting planned for next year. A June 2026 internal audit finding recorded no inventory of AI systems. Your stated objective is governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027.

**What the Briefing covers**

The Briefing will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to each use case as expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. This includes chatbot transparency and the risk classification of visual inspection, which remains an open question. United States requirements are not among the stated drivers and will appear only as general landscape. The readiness discussion will address the Piloting maturity level and how an AI system inventory could be built. It will also address two stated constraints: customer data must stay in the EU, and the German works council must be consulted before anything touches production staff.

The operating model draws on the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen), with AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards) at board level. It explores alignment with the Client's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS, ISO 9001 quality management system and internal audit function ahead of ISO/IEC 42001 work. The Briefing applies Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human. No certification, audit outcome or regulatory approval is promised.

**Logistics and price**

The Executive Briefing runs two hours, live virtual, for executive leadership and board-level attendees, at US$3,000. The audience roles identified are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. Attendance will be confirmed at intake.

**What you receive afterward**

You receive a follow-up memo recording the decisions surfaced and our readiness observations. It also sets out three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option: Executive Workshop, Practitioner Academy or Implementation Accelerator.

**Next step**

A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. We propose a short intake call to confirm whether the chatbot handles customer data, the scope of the visual inspection pilot and session dates.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
